title: The weekly and monthly report pages are near copies of each other (412 shared lines).
evidence:
jscpd: Clone found (typescript)
 - apps/web/app/reports/weekly/page.tsx [40:1 - 452:2] (412 lines)
   apps/web/app/reports/monthly/page.tsx [38:1 - 450:2]
why_it_matters: Every report bug has to be fixed twice, and the copies have already drifted (monthly lacks the timezone fix).
remediation: Extract a ReportPage component into apps/web/components/report/ReportPage.tsx that takes the period as a prop, and render it from both pages.
verified_by: Diffed the two files; 97% identical after renaming the period variable.

title: buildReport is one 1,420-line function that loads data, computes totals, and formats output.
why_it_matters: Nobody can change one part safely without reading all of it, and agents keep appending to it.
remediation: Split apps/api/src/reports/build.ts into load.ts, totals.ts, and format.ts behind the same buildReport signature; no behavior change.
verified_by: Counted lines between the function's braces with the TypeScript parser.

title: Eleven components in apps/web/components/legacy/ are imported by nothing.
why_it_matters: Dead files slow down search and mislead agents into reusing outdated patterns.
remediation: Delete apps/web/components/legacy/ after confirming no dynamic import references it (grep for 'legacy/').
verified_by: Grepped for dynamic imports and string references; none found.

title: Two dependencies, moment and lodash, are installed but never imported.
evidence:
knip: Unused dependencies (2)
moment  apps/web/package.json
lodash  apps/web/package.json
why_it_matters: They add install time and attack surface for no benefit.
remediation: Remove moment and lodash from apps/web/package.json and run pnpm install.
verified_by: Searched for require and import of both names, including dynamic imports.
